evidence.detail: Player page shows only a 'Matches List…' link under Head to Head — no individual recent match rows are rendered on the page itself
person_matches() endpoint loads all matches for the separate personmatches page; the main person() controller does not load match rows for the player page
load_matches() already accepts a limit parameter; load_matches_by_person() just doesn't pass one, making it a small addition to support 'last N'

triage.fix_sketch: 1) Add an optional `limit` arg to `load_matches_by_person` in `decksite/data/match.py` (pass it through to `load_matches`). 2) In `decksite/controllers/people.py`, load the last ~10 matches and pass them to the `Person` view. 3) Add a 'Recent Matches' section to `decksite/templates/person.mustache` reusing the match row markup from `personmatches.mustache`, followed by a 'All Matches…' link to `matches_url`.
triage.notes: The separate full-list person matches page (personmatches.mustache) already exists. This adds a recent-matches summary to the main player page, which is the original ask.
